displayTitle: Make Your Own Pop-Up Book: Ghoul-Actic Halloween
synopsis: Color and create haunting 3D paper models and bring the world of Star Wars to life in Star Wars: A Ghoul-actic Halloween Pop-Up Book.Explore the dark side of the most haunted of holidays with Star Wars: A Ghoul-actic Halloween Pop-Up Book. Step-by-step instructions guide readers to construct and color holiday-themed 3D pop-ups. Each pop-up is easy and fun to build, from Sith-style pumpkins to a collection of Porgs that trick-or-squeak, this unique Halloween celebration is sure to give even the most serene Jedi a frightfully good time.
title: Make Your Own Pop-Up Book: Ghoul-Actic Halloween
